title: The duration slider offers lengths the cloud video models reject
description: Measured 2026-09-21 in a live renderer: with seedance-15-pro-cloud picked, the duration slider in the settings popup renders min=1 max=30. That model publishes 4-12 seconds (durationRangeFor('ByteDance/Seedance-1.5-Pro'), parsed from the price snapshot's own prose). buildSizeFields clamps on the way out, so nothing is over-billed against the pick and no request is rejected - the defect is the CONTROL. A user who drags to 30 gets a 12-second clip, is billed for 12, and nothing on screen said so; since MPI-852 the price tag quotes the clamped length, so the number and the slider visibly disagree. Fix: bound the duration control by the model's own published range when the model is cloud (provider + cloud.endpointId). Local models keep 1-30. The four shipped ranges differ (Seedance 1.5 4-12, Seedance 2.0 4-15, Wan 3.0 2-30) and Veo 3.1 publishes no duration field at all - that one is a separate defect (a control that changes nothing) and is NOT in scope here. Control: 'duration' in js/components/Organisms/MpiPromptBox/PromptBoxControls.js, nodeTitle Input_Duration.
